turns.text: to fetch the consent do i pass the consentRequest.id i got on on-init? or is that a different id

must_contain: The consent request id from on-init identifies the request, and the status call and the patient's decision refer to it.
Consent fetch takes a consent artefact id, which arrives in consentArtefacts on a GRANTED notification, and one request can produce several.
notes: The two ids are the M3 pair people mix up; sending the request id to fetch is the wrong answer. Source lines: catalogue/hiecm/callbacks/m3-on-consent-request-init.md, '`consentRequest.id` is the consent request id. Store it: the patient's decision and any status check refer to it.'; catalogue/hiecm/callbacks/m3-on-consent-request-notify-hiu.md, '`GRANTED`: `consentArtefacts` lists the id of every [consent artefact] created. Store all of them.' and 'fetch each one through `/api/hiecm/consent/v3/fetch`'; catalogue/hiecm/endpoints/m3-consent-fetch.md, 'Fetch a [consent artefact] by its id after a `GRANTED` [consent notification]' and 'the artefact ids from the notification'. Review: must_not_contain 'pass the consentRequest.id to fetch' removed: a correct 'do not pass the consentRequest.id to fetch' matched it.
